question: Special Drawing Rights are also known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paper Gold.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **SDRs **are international reserve assets created by the **International Monetary Fund** (IMF) in **1969** to supplement the foreign exchange reserves of member countries.
